## Summary
- What changed?
- Why was it needed?

## Linked issue
- Closes #<issue-number>

## Acceptance proof
- [ ] Change works in the intended flow
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Proof of outcome is attached or described

## AMA routing labels on linked issue
- [ ] Exactly one ama:owner:* label is set
- [ ] Exactly one ama:tier:* label is set

## Risk check
- [ ] No security/auth/secrets impact
- [ ] No schema or data migration
- [ ] No infrastructure or deployment change
- [ ] No high-blast-radius or irreversible change

If any risk item above is not true, explain it here and note whether board review is required.

## Reviewer focus
- What should the reviewer pay special attention to?
